goal_intent: work out whether to eat here this weekend, then book if it suits

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m thinking of organising a little get-together with friends this weekend, and I was wondering if your place is good for groups. We’re looking for somewhere with a nice atmosphere where we can actually hear each other talk.
Oh, thanks for asking! There will be five of us, so not a huge crowd, but enough that we’d need a decent-sized table. I’m just hoping we can all sit together and not get split up!
We were thinking about this Sunday, since everyone is finally free at the same time! I hope you’re not too busy then — it’s always tricky finding a spot on the weekend.
6:30pm would be perfect for us, just early enough to catch up before it gets too late. That way we can linger a bit and not be rushed. Can you book us in for that time?

That’s great, thank you! No allergies or dietary requirements this time, everyone’s pretty easy-going. The booking can go under Marcus Bell — he’s actually the one who always pays for dinner, so it’s only fair he gets the reservation too!
Wonderful, I really appreciate it! We’re all looking forward to it — thanks for making the reservation so easy. See you Sunday! [END OF CALL]
